findings.message: The logged plan was COLLSCAN: every document was read. The index recommendations below target this query shape.
docsExamined 1843220 vs nreturned 20 (about 92161:1): the query reads far more documents than it returns. The target is close to 1:1.

skip(2000) walks and discards 2000 index keys or documents on every page, and on a sharded collection mongos asks each shard for limit+skip. Use keyset pagination: sort on a unique key and filter { _id: { $gt: lastSeenId } } with limit().
hasSortStage: the result was sorted in memory (blocking sort, 100 MB limit). Put the sort keys in the index right after the equality keys.
usedDisk: a blocking stage spilled to disk. Slim the stream ($match / $project earlier) before the sort or group instead of raising memory limits.

status: $ne cannot use selective index bounds and also matches documents missing the field. Where the domain is known, match the wanted values positively ($in / equality) — this changes results unless the field is always present, so it is not auto-applied.
durationMillis 4981 is at the maxTimeMS 5000 cap: this is a timeout-bounded baseline, not the query's real latency.

indexes.rationale: ESR order: equality customerId -> sort createdAt. The sort key createdAt also serves its range predicate.
